facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Typically 10%–15% equity; amount/stake depend on capital needs and company stage
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 全职、100% committed 的创始团队；优先完整 builder team。接受从 idea 到已有收入的公司；B2B/enterprise 可更早，consumer 通常需要更多产品市场验证。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 强 founder-market fit；完整技术/产品执行能力；真实客户或早期收入；愿意接受极深度、长期 operator-style 介入。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 不要求搬到 Los Angeles。Mucker 官方明确可 remote 参与；平均合作约12个月，实际可短至3个月、长至24个月。
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes / geography-agnostic for company location; practical US investment constraints may apply
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 无 relocation 要求；官网明确表示不在意你住哪里。未公开 visa sponsorship。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 公司网址、HQ、类别、产品阶段、pitch deck、ARR/近12月收入、MoM growth、融资目标、已融资金额；founding team/客户/竞争/商业模式等补充信息建议填写。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 通过 Mucker Submit Company / Apply Now；建议参加官方 info sessions。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Pre-seed–Series A 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品；只有想法、无 MVP/traction 的极早期项目
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：适合希望得到长期深度运营支持、而非短期 Demo Day 的 pre-seed/seed 公司。Consumer 无明显 PMF 时较难；纯融资诉求不匹配。

facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Typically 10%–15% equity; amount/stake depend on capital needs and company stage
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Fully committed founder teams, preferably with complete building capabilities. Idea-stage to revenue-stage companies accepted; consumer companies generally need more validation than B2B companies.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Strong founder-market fit, technical and product execution, customers or early revenue, and willingness to work deeply with operators over time.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Relocation to Los Angeles is not required. Mucker explicitly permits remote participation; engagement averages approximately 12 months and can range from three to 24 months.
facts.International Founder: Yes / geography-agnostic for company location; practical US investment constraints may apply
facts.Visa / Relocation: No relocation requirement; the website explicitly permits any home location. Visa sponsorship is not published.
facts.Application Materials: Website, headquarters, category, product stage, deck, ARR or trailing-year revenue, monthly growth, fundraising target and capital raised. Team, customer, competitor and business-model details are recommended.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use Mucker Submit Company or Apply Now; official information sessions are recommended.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Pre-seed–Series A stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Traditional offline businesses without a scalable technology product; Idea-only projects without an MVP or traction
facts.Notes: Best for pre-seed and seed companies seeking sustained operational support. Consumer companies without clear product-market fit, or teams seeking funding only, are less suitable.
